text:
Priya Nair: Hi all, second day and a couple quick issues: my monitor arrived but no HDMI cable in the box, the USB-C dock charges the laptop but the external display doesn't wake (shows detected but stays black), and corp-secure wifi (802.1X) keeps failing after I authenticate via SSO. Who should I nudge?

Ben - IT: Welcome Priya! :wave: Sorry for the hassle. Can you confirm OS (mac/Win) and whether direct-attach HDMI to laptop works? Also I'll open a ticket if you want.

Priya Nair: I'm on macOS Ventura. Direct-attaching the monitor to the laptop using my own spare cable works fine, so monitor panel is ok. When hooked to the dock it shows as a display in System Settings but stays black.

Ben - IT: Got it. That often means the dock isn't providing the proper DP/HDMI handshake. Quick try: System Settings -> Displays -> Arrangement -> uncheck "Mirror" and toggle refresh rate to 60Hz. If still black, run in Terminal: `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` and paste the USB hub block. I'll create ticket IT-355001 to track.

Priya Nair: Trying the refresh rate toggle now... no change. system_profiler shows the dock enumerated as "Vendor: BrixTech, DockModel: Brix-UI".

Ben - IT: Thanks. I've created IT-355001 and added you. For immediate onboarding, do you need internet for the next hour? I can issue a one-hour VPN token. Also I'll request an HDMI cable + VESA screw kit shipped and schedule a remote driver push at 15:30 PT.

ship-bot: [IT-355001] Parts order placed: HDMI cable (2m) + VESA M4 screws. ETA next business day.

Olga (Facilities): If you want the screws sooner I can drop by with a small parts bag. Desk location?

Priya Nair: Desk B-7. If you can drop the screws that would be amazing, I have orientation at 2pm. VPN token would help too.

Ben - IT: Sent one-hour VPN token via DM. Also scheduled remote driver push at 15:30 PT; tagging IT-355001 to watch. If driver push doesn't fix display we'll swap the dock. For 802.1X: on mac, open Keychain Access and delete any items with the corp wifi hostname, then reboot and try joining again. If it still fails, reply here and I'll push a network profile.

Olga (Facilities): Dropped screws at B-7 desk locker.

Priya Nair: Got the screws, thanks Olga. VPN token worked and I joined the call. Will report back after the driver push.

Ben - IT: Great. Closing loop for now: IT-355001 will track HDMI cable shipping, screw drop, driver push, and wifi profile follow-up. Reply to this thread with any new errors or logs. :thumbsup:
